premise.situation: A man boils the kettle, forgets, and reboils it every time he walks past
premise.turn: He has boiled the same water eleven times and still has not made the tea
premise.detail: he reboils it out of habit before checking whether it is hot

character_sheet: a man in his thirties, unbrushed hair, dressing gown, standing in a kitchen

beats.text: I boiled the kettle at nine o'clock this morning.
It is now half past two and I have not had a cup of tea.
Every time I walk past it I press the button again. Automatically.
Not because it is cold. I do not check whether it is cold. I just press it.
It rumbles, it clicks off, and I walk out of the room with nothing.
That same water has now been boiled eleven separate times.
At this point I think it is personal.
